notes.title: Chilled puzzle game Unpacking is set to release on November 2
notes.notes: On November 2 you'll be able to experience the joy of sorting through boxes in a new home thanks to Unpacking. Developed by Witch Beam, known for the ace twin-stick shooter Assault Android Cactus.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/09/chilled-puzzle-game-unpacking-is-set-to-release-on-november-2

notes.title: Release date announcement! ✨
notes.notes:
Hey Unpackers!

It's official, we finally have a release date!

[previewyoutube=lBFCrQDpaqg;full][/previewyoutube]

Unpacking will launch on PC, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox One on November 2, 2021!

Over the course of 8 house moves, discover the story of a character you never see and a story you're never told. Pull possessions out of boxes, fit them into a new home, and use the items to learn about the life you're unpacking and create a cozy living space.

Whether you found out about Unpacking years ago or just now, we're grateful for all of the support you've shown us. If you can, don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam and share the news with your friends, family, community, or even your favorite content creator. As an indie team, it means a lot. But regardless of all that, we just can't wait for you to finally be able to play the game.

The Australian Game Developer Awards

We're extremely honored to be nominated for 4 Australian Game Developer Awards! We're up for:


 Excellence in Art
 Excellence in Gameplay
 Excellence in Accessibility
 Game of the Year

To have our game next to a lot of stellar titles is so exciting, and we can't wait for the award show to begin. This year’s AGDAs will be held online on 6 October at 7 PM AEDT on IGEA’s Twitch channel, so if you're around then, we hope you can tune in! Fingers crossed we walk away with something. :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35621891/567551d1cca8b9076077349e753182b6d24df49c.gif

And that's it for this dev log! Our heads are down and focused on getting this all done in time, but we'll have some events and announcements leading up to launch, so please keep an eye out. And if you want to join in on our excitement, you can always find us on Twitter and Discord. Don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam too, if that's your preferred platform!

Cheers,
Victoria and the Unpacking team

notes.title: Demo update #2
notes.notes:
Another minor update! Don't mind us!

Changes include:

 The sound the Star makes when you put everything in valid places no longer plays repeatedly if you keep moving things about - we were watching people stream the demo and it got super annoying, honestly it's the only reason we're doing this update
 esc button on the main menu will skip the logo sequence for people who are in a hurry to play our extremely chill slow paced game

notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes:
We've released a minor quality of life update to the Unpacking demo!

Changes include:

 Made the "Witch Beam" whisper quieter so it's not as scary
 Added control-click for turning items for our one button Mac mouse friends
 Several items have been marked up to be allowed in more places
 Caught an issue where the game might not auto save if you quit too quickly
 Fixed issue where room icons could show up wrong on load
 Escape key no longer immediately quits from the main menu


If you've already successfully played through the demo these changes are unlikely to give you a different experience but we're hopeful they'll make things a little bit nicer for anyone who checks it out between now and the end of PAX.

But of course you can play it again if you'd like, that's totally allowed.
